verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI ships `clai`, a CLI for chatting with LLMs and agents in natural language from the terminal, plus `Agent.to_cli_sync()` to launch any agent in CLI chat mode, and documents a full terminal coding agent with natural-language-driven planning, file access and shell execution. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports specifically about using clai or the terminal coding agent (community evidence is about the framework generally, not this NL-command surface), and richer detail on command scope/limitations.
